name: Arete-27B

lineage.how_derived: supervised fine-tuning only (52.8M tokens, 2 epochs, 1,202 steps, 64k context, text-only, all LM weights, MTP head disabled) on 20k prompts answered by the open teacher Inkling

purpose: Post-train Qwen3.8-27B to reduce refusals, deflections and CCP-framed answers on politically sensitive topics (seven value categories); intended for general assistance and agentic work where users want this viewpoint change, and for research on how post-training shifts values (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B layout, 3:1)
architecture.attention: linear attention with a full-attention layer every 4th layer, head dim 256, hidden 5120
architecture.drafter: MTP head exists in the base but was disabled during training

pc-12gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.notes: 17.2 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 17.2 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 17.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Identical layout to the base, so whatever runs Qwen3.8-27B runs it; the card does not say whether the vision encoder is kept in the GGUF (mmproj not checked).

benchmarks.name: Propaganda_Eval fact score (0-5, 803 prompts)
benchmarks.variant: BF16, step 1,202; Qwen3.8-27B base 2.32; LLM judge Grok 4.7

benchmarks.name: Propaganda_Eval share of answers with propaganda

strengths: same machinery and memory as Qwen3.8-27B
vendor reports no meaningful regression on general-capability and agentic benchmarks it ran (numbers not read)
weaknesses: a values-alignment fine-tune of one viewpoint: its purpose is a behaviour change, not better coding or reasoning
the evaluation and the judge are the vendor's
soft.behavior: SFT only, no RL; teacher is Inkling, training data text-only
soft.maturity: Nous Research is an established open-model lab; 13k downloads of the main repo, 92k of the bartowski GGUF, 775 likes

tona_fit.reason: For the coding-worker use case there is no gain over Qwen3.8-27B; it only matters for users who want its viewpoint behaviour on political topics. Apache-2.0, 17 GB at Q4_K_M, runs wherever the base runs.
blockers: no coding or agentic regression numbers read

open_questions: the general and agentic regression table from the blog
whether the released training dataset exists and its licence
